events.text: Carlos Sainz Jr. was born.
Sainz raced in the British and European Formula 3 championships for Carlin.
Sainz raced for DAMS in the Formula Renault 3.5 season and won the championship.
Sainz moved to McLaren and ended his contract with Red Bull Racing.
Sainz finished second at Monza.
Sainz finished second for Scuderia Ferrari at the Monaco Grand Prix.
Sainz won the Asia-Pacific KF3 title.
Sainz finished runner-up in the Spanish Championship.
Sainz won the Junior Monaco Kart Cup.
Sainz was runner-up in the European KF3 Championship.
Sainz raced in Formula BMW Europe with the EuroInternational team.
Sainz made his Formula BMW debut in the Formula BMW Pacific series at Sepang.
Sainz finished 4th in the Formula BMW Pacific series championship.
Sainz competed in the UK Formula Renault Winter Cup at Snetterton.
Sainz raced in both British and Euro Series Formula 3 championships.
Sainz won four races, finished nine times on the podium, and scored a pole position in the British Formula 3 championship.
Sainz finished sixth overall in the British Formula 3 championship standings.
Sainz scored two podiums and two pole positions in the Euro Series Formula 3 championship.
Sainz finished in ninth position overall in the Euro Series Formula 3 championship.
Sainz signed with Arden to compete in the GP3 series.
Sainz raced in Formula Renault 3.5 for the first time.
Sainz retired in race 1 and scored 6th place in the last race weekend of the year in Catalunya.
Sainz switched teams to DAMS.
Sainz won the second race at the season opener at Monza.
Sainz won at Aragon.
Sainz won race 1 at the Nurburgring Gp Circuit.
Sainz won in France.
Sainz was announced as a test driver for both Red Bull and Toro Rosso.
Sainz drove for Scuderia Toro Rosso.
Sainz qualified inside the top ten for his début at the Australian Grand Prix and finished ninth.
Sainz crashed during the third free practice session of the Russian Grand Prix.
Sainz did not finish the Russian Grand Prix.
Sainz finished 7th in the United States Grand Prix.
Sainz finished 15th in his first season with Toro Rosso.
Sainz finished 12th in the driver standings at the end of the season.
Sainz moved to Renault beginning with the United States Grand Prix.
Sainz finished 9th in the driver standings.
Sainz finished the season in tenth place.
Sainz moved to McLaren.
Sainz earned his first podium in Formula One.
Sainz finished 6th in the drivers championship.
Sainz finished second at the Italian Grand Prix.
Sainz finished the season in 6th place of the drivers championship.
Sainz joined Scuderia Ferrari.
Sainz took his third career podium and first with Ferrari at the Monaco Grand Prix.
